title: Claude for Google Workspace duyuruldu
summary: Anthropic, Claude yapay zeka asistanını Google Docs, Sheets ve Slides uygulamalarına entegre eden yeni eklentisini duyurdu.
body:
Claude için geliştirilen yeni Google Workspace entegrasyonu, Google Dokümanlar, E-Tablolar ve Slaytlar uygulamalarında yan panel üzerinden kullanım sunmaya başladı. Dijital Trends ve 9to5Google sitelerinin aktardığına göre, ücretli Claude kullanıcılarına halka açık beta olarak sunulan bu eklenti, dosyalar üzerinde doğrudan düzenleme yapılmasına olanak tanıyor.

## Claude Google uygulamalarında neler yapabiliyor?

Google Docs içerisinde metinleri yeniden biçimlendirmek, yazım hatalarını düzeltmek ve öneri kartları oluşturmak mümkün kılınıyor. Google Sheets tarafında ise yapay zeka formüller yazabiliyor, tablolar oluşturabiliyor ve karmaşık işlemler için Python dilini kullanabiliyor. Google Slides uygulamasında ise sunum düzenine uygun yeni sayfalar eklenebiliyor ve okunabilirlik denetimleri yapılabiliyor. Eklentinin yanı sıra, dosya bağlantılarını Claude sohbetine yapıştırarak doğrudan düzenleme yapılmasına imkan tanıyan bağlayıcılar da sunuluyor.

## Kullanım modları ve erişim

Varsayılan olarak Claude, yapılan değişiklikleri uygulamadan önce kullanıcıdan onay istiyor ancak dileyen kullanıcılar için otomatik modu etkinleştirmek de mümkün. Güncel olarak tüm ücretli Claude planlarında kullanılabilen bu beta eklentiye Google Workspace Marketplace üzerinden erişilebiliyor.

**Neden önemli?** Google Workspace ekosisteminde uzun süredir yer alan Gemini seçeneğine karşı Claude alternatifini getiren bu entegrasyon, kullanıcıların kendi tercih ettikleri yapay zeka asistanıyla doğrudan ofis belgeleri üzerinde çalışabilmesini sağlıyor.

source_texts.title: Claude just stepped into Google Workspace with in-file editing, automated Sheets work, and smarter Slides
source_texts.summary: Anthropic's new add-on lets Claude read and edit your open Docs, Sheets, and Slides files, with approval controls.
source_texts.text:
Gemini has enjoyed home-turf advantage in Google’s apps for over two years. Call it too late, but Claude just wandered onto the field.
Anthropic’s new Claude for Google Workspace add-on, available in public beta across every paid plan, adds a sidebar to Docs, Sheets, and Slides that can read and edit your open file and provide answers based on it.
What can Claude actually do inside my files?
A lot, actually. Highlight something and Claude sees exactly what you picked. In Docs, it can polish a sentence, reformat a heading, and highlight the keywords in a pitch or a deck. Bigger rewrites, something that approaches the same idea from a different angle, show up as suggestion cards you can accept or ignore.
Sheets got me most curious, though. Claude can now write formulas, build pivot tables (quick summaries of raw rows), and native charts. If that’s not enough, Claude can use Python to do the heavy lifting and automatically update your Sheet with the clean results for complex tasks like merging tables or fixing errors.
Slides get new pages built from your deck’s own layouts, plus a self-audit for overlap and unreadable text, which I’d say is the smartest touch.
How does it stack up against Gemini and ChatGPT?
It’s worth mentioning that Claude doesn’t change anything without your permission. Speaking with some experience, that’s the right setting for week one. An “Accept all edits” mode lets Claude run solo, something that heavy users will enable right away. To my dismay, the sidebar can’t touch other Drive files or Docs comments, and Slides charts arrive as images.
Coming back to what I mentioned at the beginning, Gemini has lived in Workspace side panels since June 2024, so Claude is the one catching up here. ChatGPT began showing Drive files beside its chat on August 13 and can update them, though that happens inside ChatGPT rather than Google’s own apps.
Claude now covers both the in-file sidebar and chat-based editing, which, if you ask me, is one of the chatbot’s biggest advantages.

source_texts.title: Claude launches Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides integration with sidebar and more
source_texts.summary: If Gemini isn’t quite your cup of tea, Anthropic’s Claude now supports sidebar integration with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. more…
source_texts.text:
If Gemini isn’t quite your cup of tea, Anthropic’s Claude now supports sidebar integration with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
You can already use Gemini natively in Google Workspace apps, but those invested in Claude can now use their AI of choice inside of Google’s ecosystem through the Claude for Google Workspace add-on which is in public beta starting today. A sidebar opens up alongside your file in Docs, Sheets, or Slides and can assist in building out documents, making edits, and more.
In Google Docs, Anthropic says you can use Claude integration to fix spelling, rewrite portions of a document, or restyle sections, all without breaking existing formatting. In Sheets, you can have Claude write formulas or build tables using the context of the document, or even upload extra documents/spreadsheets to build something new in Sheets. In Slides, Claude can build new slides using existing layouts or themes or flag elements that might need to be updated. Gemini can do much of this but, as mentioned, this is useful for those already invested in Claude.
There’s an “ask before edits” mode where Claude will let you preview changes before they’re made.
The Claude for Google Workspace beta is available to all paid Claude users through the Google Workspace marketplace. There are also new Claude connectors for Docs, Sheets, and Slides that let you edit Google Workspace files directly from Claude itself just by pasting a file link into your conversation with the AI.
